title: PassGPT+: Leveraging Linguistic Priors for Password Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.39880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Passwords remain the dominant online authentication mechanism, and understanding how humans choose them is essential for defensive strength estimation and attack simulation alike. Recent learning-based approaches such as PassGAN and PassGPT have shown that deep generative models can learn password structure directly from leaked corpora. However, both train from random initialization on password data alone. The role of linguistic prior knowledge in password modeling, and what it reveals about how humans create secrets, remains largely underexplored. Here, we address this gap with PassGPT+, which adapts the linguistic prior of GPT-2 to password observations through character-aware tokenization. We also introduce PassDiffusion, the first absorbing-state discrete diffusion model for password generation, as a probe of whether non-autoregressive approaches are competitive. translated_title: PassGPT+：利用语言先验进行密码建模
translated_abstract: 密码仍然是主流的在线身份验证机制，理解人类如何选择密码对于防御性的强度评估和攻击模拟都至关重要。最近的基于学习的方法（如PassGAN和PassGPT）已经表明，深度生成模型可以直接从泄露的语料库中学习密码结构。然而，这两种方法都是从随机初始化开始，仅使用密码数据进行训练。语言先验知识在密码建模中的作用，以及它能揭示人类如何创建秘密信息的规律，在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。在本文中，我们通过PassGPT+来填补这一空白，该方法通过字符感知的分词方式将GPT-2的语言先验适配到密码数据上。我们还引入了PassDiffusion，这是第一个用于密码生成的吸收态离散扩散模型，用以探究非自回归方法是否具有竞争力。在RockYou基准测试上，PassGPT+恢复了22.53%的保留密码……
tldr: PassGPT+通过字符感知分词将GPT-2的语言先验引入密码建模，在RockYou基准上恢复22.53%的保留密码，并提出了首个吸收态离散扩散密码生成模型PassDiffusion。
en_tdlr: PassGPT+ adapts GPT-2's linguistic priors to password modeling through character-aware tokenization, recovering 22.53% of held-out passwords on the RockYou benchmark, and introduces PassDiffusion, the first absorbing-state discrete diffusion model for password generation.
